term: task adequacy and minimum-channel practical adoption
definition: Adequate f t reuses CorrectionCriterion.AdmitsCriterion for the task truth predicate through encode f. Adopted chooses an adequate proposal with least retained-coordinate count among the two candidates. Tasks ask the first or second coordinate. Switching a task is changing a goal, not observing the hidden coordinate. This stipulated pragmatic policy is not categorical normative authority, actual efficiency or a historical attribution.
